title: Quite expensive compared to features provided
body: Subscription quite expensive compared to features provided even with “special offer” which was much cheaper than original price. For this amount of money I would expect more than 9 colors to chose from, and better calendar view, more statistics of achievements and so on. Major updates needed imo.
author: lszabolcs

title: New Premium Upgrade
body: I really liked the app, i even paid for premium, but then it upgraded and i do not have premium anymore and it’s too pricey now. I actually want my money back.
